BiblicalUsage: Ahithophel was David's counsellor, whose advice was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God, until he went over to Absalom and, seeing his counsel rejected, went home and hanged himself.
TheologicalSignificance: Wisdom without loyalty curdles into treason — that is what I hold his story to teach. The cleverest man in the kingdom could not save himself, because he had chosen the wrong king.
RelatedPeople: King David; Absalom; Ahithophel the Gilonite
